justification.destructiveHint: Does not delete, replace, cancel, or revoke business data; only the connection activity timestamp is updated.
justification.openWorldHint: Limited to templates in the authenticated organization that the caller can access within Guteneo; it does not browse arbitrary external resources or contact recipients.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Creates a persistent postal review and consumes a PDF-analysis allowance while checking the exact original, address and qualified postal profile. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Adds analysis and review evidence without altering the original PDF, approving a provider transfer or sending mail.
justification.openWorldHint: Uses a private PDF, internal rendering and the fixed configured Pingen profile; it does not deposit a PDF at Pingen or contact the recipient.
justification.idempotentHint: The same key and exact request reuse the postal review. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Persists a prepared dispatch and quote and may create draft protected-document hosting. Qualified production email preparation may provision the sender and pricing, enable the account email control under existing gates, revoke already expired automatic policies, and clear already expired protected-hosting secrets. It does not accept or send the dispatch. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Adds a preparation and optional draft hosting without replacing a live dispatch or original PDF. Housekeeping affects only already expired automatic policies and hosting secrets, which cannot authorize current access. It does not revoke valid access, approve or send the dispatch.
justification.openWorldHint: Limited to Guteneo records and bounded reads from the configured private delivery-provider account when needed for a quote. A recipient is stored as preparation data but is not contacted.
justification.idempotentHint: The same idempotency key deduplicates dispatch preparation. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Persists an immutable PDF-hash, channel and recipient manifest, freezes the source generation job against further retries, and prepares individual dispatch records. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Creating the persistent distribution plan permanently prevents retryGeneration for the source job, including failed records excluded from this plan. The tool therefore removes an existing recovery path even though it retains original PDFs and inputs and does not approve or send any dispatch.
justification.openWorldHint: Creates records within Guteneo's configured delivery workflow; it does not submit a delivery request to a provider or send a message to the supplied recipients.
justification.idempotentHint: The same key and exact request reuse the immutable distribution plan, but a replay calls resumeDistribution with retryFailed=true and may advance unfinished preparation entries. It is therefore not idempotent even before the common production connection-activity update.

justification.readOnlyHint: Persists a fax preparation and quote. With renewalOf it creates a replacement linked to an eligible obsolete preparation and cancels that earlier preparation. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: The optional renewalOf path permanently cancels the prior prepared dispatch. The new quote is a separate preparation and any sendable quote requires a new approval; these guards do not remove the cancellation effect.
justification.openWorldHint: Prepares records inside Guteneo and uses configured pricing; it does not submit the PDF to the recipient or delivery provider.
justification.idempotentHint: The supplied key deduplicates preparation; renewal also has a stable key derived from the obsolete quote. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Reserves rendering budget, renders the selected draft revision, and saves a new private PDF with document checks. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Adds a new preview document without replacing the template or existing generated PDFs.
justification.openWorldHint: Uses Guteneo's bound document-rendering and scanning services, then private document storage; it does not contact a recipient.
justification.idempotentHint: A repeat can reserve another render and create another private preview PDF. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Reads a bounded page of the retained dataset profile and anomalies without calling AI. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Does not delete, replace, cancel, or revoke business data; only the connection activity timestamp is updated.
justification.openWorldHint: Limited to the stored profile of a caller-owned dataset within Guteneo; it does not browse arbitrary external resources or contact recipients.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Adds an immutable published template version and updates the current-version pointer and revision. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Adds a new immutable version while retaining all earlier published versions and generated PDFs.
justification.openWorldHint: Publishes only within the existing Guteneo template and its organization permissions, not to a public website or arbitrary recipient.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Reads the existing provider draft and records a prepared dispatch with its exact quote, bounded by the previously reviewed document and options. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Adds a dispatch preparation and quote without deleting the provider draft, creating send approval or dispatching postal mail.
justification.openWorldHint: Uses only the configured private provider account and existing draft, without a new arbitrary upload or recipient communication.
justification.idempotentHint: The supplied key deduplicates the resulting dispatch preparation. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Reads the verified immutable PDF and renders a bounded group of page images. It does not persist expert review progress or create an approval token. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Does not replace the original PDF, revoke existing review tokens, prepare a dispatch or send a communication.
justification.openWorldHint: Uses private Guteneo storage and its bound rendering service for an authorized document; no caller-selected network destination is accessed.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Consumes rendering allowance, renders controlled HTML and persists a new PDF and its document analysis. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Adds a separate PDF without replacing an existing original or sending a communication.
justification.openWorldHint: Uses self-contained HTML, private Guteneo storage and its fixed internal rendering and scanning services. Rendering controls prevent arbitrary web navigation or resource fetching.
justification.idempotentHint: A repeat can consume rendering allowance and create a new PDF. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Can reserve a daily rescan attempt, claim an analysis lease, rerun scanning and update analysis and document readiness. Existing ready or processing cases may return without a new scan. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Preserves the immutable PDF bytes while completing or updating analysis state; it neither removes the document nor cancels or sends a dispatch.
justification.openWorldHint: Uses an existing authorized private PDF and the configured internal scanner; it does not download an arbitrary source or contact recipients.
justification.idempotentHint: An eligible repeat can consume another daily analysis attempt and update analysis state. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Prepares up to three remaining distribution entries and persists their dispatch identifiers or error status. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Adds missing preparations or retries explicitly selected failed preparations without replacing the immutable manifest or sending documents.
justification.openWorldHint: Runs Guteneo dispatch preparation against an existing private manifest and configured delivery workflow; it does not submit a delivery request, transfer a postal draft, or contact recipients.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Claims an analysis attempt, scans and profiles the stored original, persists the profile, and updates its analysis status. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Preserves the immutable original and its hash while adding or completing analysis results; attempts are bounded to three.
justification.openWorldHint: Reuses the original in private Guteneo storage and the configured scanner; it does not download a new URL, call AI, or contact recipients.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Requeues selected failed records for bounded processing and may update the job state to queued. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Retries only failed records with fewer than three attempts, preserves rendered artifacts, and refuses cancelled jobs or jobs frozen by an existing distribution.
justification.openWorldHint: Reuses the private job, its fixed inputs, and Guteneo's configured rendering services; no recipients are contacted.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Persists expert-review page progress and creates or replaces the temporary review token bound to the exact dispatch, content, recipient, ceiling and active mandate. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: A completed new review overwrites the token hash for the same dispatch and connection, invalidating a previously usable review token even before its expiry. Restarting page review may reset its saved progress. It does not itself approve or send the dispatch, but that does not remove the token-replacement effect.
justification.openWorldHint: Limited to the authorized private Guteneo dispatch and PDF, rendered through a bound internal service; it does not submit content to a delivery provider.
justification.idempotentHint: A completed repeat creates a new token and invalidates the preceding token; restarting page review can also reset progress. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Changes template visibility and replaces the template's per-member permissions after membership and revision checks. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Replaces all current per-member grants and visibility, which can revoke existing access. It retains template content, original sources, and PDFs.
justification.openWorldHint: Sharing is restricted to existing members of the authenticated organization; it cannot send to an arbitrary address or publish publicly.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Persists an organization AI usage reservation and requests a bounded proposal from the configured provider. A reserved call is not refunded if the provider fails. It does not save the proposed template changes. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Returns a proposal for review without overwriting, publishing, or deleting the template; it increments the AI usage counter.
justification.openWorldHint: Uses the fixed OpenAI Responses API endpoint only after organization configuration and browser-admin transfer approval; it cannot select an arbitrary destination.
justification.idempotentHint: A repeated proposal request reserves another AI call and may return a different proposal. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Records current delegated transfer authority and uploads the checked PDF and address to the configured private Pingen account as a draft with automatic sending disabled. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Starting a transfer irreversibly consumes this existing preflight's one-shot transfer attempt: the allowed state transitions never return to not_started, and even an unknown outcome cannot be retried. The operation also uploads the PDF and creates a durable draft in the configured private provider account with auto_send disabled. A bounded mandate, exact fingerprint and transfer gates are required; no letter is sent by this tool. This classification rests on permanent workflow closure, not merely on network access or an assumption about provider data retention.
justification.openWorldHint: Uploads only to the fixed authorized origins and private Pingen account configured for Guteneo. It does not accept an arbitrary destination or contact the postal recipient.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Replaces the existing draft definition or applies a semantic patch, then increments its revision under expectedRevision concurrency checks. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Overwrites the current draft definition and name. Published versions and generated PDFs are retained; prior unpublished draft revisions are not saved by this handler.
justification.openWorldHint: Changes a permission-checked template inside the authenticated organization; it does not publish outside Guteneo.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Evaluates all dataset rows and may persist a validation summary and validated status on a draft mapping. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Adds validation information and promotes a draft to validated without changing its declarative plan or source dataset.
justification.openWorldHint: Runs deterministic validation against the caller's stored dataset and mapping inside Guteneo; no AI call or document sending occurs.
justification.idempotentHint: Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.

justification.readOnlyHint: Creates and persists a validation attempt and report, consumes allowance from an already active Horizon plan, and may settle already timed-out attempts as errors. It does not subscribe, renew a plan or alter billing. When the production connection has current observation authority, a validated successful result also attempts to persist its last-successful-use timestamp, which is visible in connection verification.
justification.destructiveHint: Adds a diagnostic report for the exact original PDF bytes without replacing a completed report. Settling an already timed-out attempt does not cancel a currently valid diagnosis. It neither modifies nor deletes the PDF, changes its security status, sends a communication, subscribes to a plan or debits a payment method.
justification.openWorldHint: Uses the authenticated organization’s existing PDF and the configured private veraPDF validation service. It does not accept an arbitrary destination or publish the document.
justification.idempotentHint: The same key and original PDF/profile reuse the saved validation report instead of consuming a second validation allowance. Repeated successful production calls can advance the persisted connection-activity timestamp, so the complete operation is not guaranteed to have no additional effect, even when its business result is reused.
